aircraft.highlight: Fresh 2022 paint & interior. Pro Line 4, Gogo AVANCE L3 Wi-Fi, thrust reversers.
aircraft.overview:
This 2002 Beechjet 400A presents exceptionally well, with both paint and interior completed in 2022. Powered by Pratt & Whitney JT15D-5R engines on a TBO Extension STC, she carries a full Collins Pro Line 4 avionics suite and is equipped for modern operations — Gogo AVANCE L3 Wi-Fi, ADS-B, RVSM certification, TCAS-II with Change 7, and EGPWS.

The seven-passenger cabin is finished in custom brown slate leather with dual fold-out tables, a fully-enclosed lavatory with sink, and USB power at the cockpit and VIP seat. A clean, well-equipped, thrust-reverser-equipped light jet ready for its next owner.

aircraft.highlight: Ultra-long-range. Engines enrolled on Rolls-Royce Corporate Care (RRCC), APU enrolled on MSP Gold.
aircraft.overview:
This 2005 Global Express XRS is fully enrolled on Rolls-Royce Corporate Care, Smart Parts Plus, MSP Gold, and Collins CASP, with a major block of airframe and landing gear inspections completed in August 2025. She shows 8,842.7 hours and 4,672 landings, tracked on CAMP and operated Part 91.

The Honeywell Primus 2000XP flight deck features synthetic vision, HUD with EVS, and auto throttles, with FANS 1/A+, RNP-4, NAT HLA, RVSM, ADS-B Out, and increased MTOW. The 15-passenger cabin was refreshed in July 2020 and includes forward and aft lavatories, crew rest, and Starlink Wi-Fi.

aircraft.highlight: Fresh 48-Month by Duncan, GE OnPoint, & MSP.
aircraft.overview:
This 1997 Challenger 604 is fresh off a 48-month inspection completed in July 2025 by Duncan Aviation in Provo, with 6- and 12-month inspections complied with in May 2026. Both GE CF34-3B engines are enrolled on GE OnPoint and the Garrett APU on MSP. She shows 8,695.1 total hours and 4,002 landings, tracked on TRAXXALL and currently operated Part 135.

The Collins Pro Line 4 flight deck includes triple FMS-6000, TCAS II with Change 7.1, Honeywell Mark V EGPWS, dual HF, and AirCell ST-3100 Satcom. The 10-passenger cabin features a forward 4-place club with a 4-place divan opposite a 2-place club, right forward galley, Airshow 400, ATG-5000 Wi-Fi, and cockpit seats recovered in new leather and sheepskin in September 2025. Exterior refurbished in 2018 in Matterhorn white and royal blue.

aircraft.highlight: Low time, fresh Phase A-D & 12-year, Engines enrolled on MSP Gold.
aircraft.overview:
This 2001 Learjet 31A has 5,923 total hours and 4,497 cycles, with both Honeywell TFE731-2-3B engines on MSP Gold. Fresh out of a Phase A–D and 12-year inspection completed December 2025 by Intercontinental Jet Services Corp.

Equipped with Raisbeck ZR LITE, aft fuselage locker, winglets, and Dee Howard TR-4000 thrust reversers. The panel includes Universal UNS-1E FMS, 5-tube EFIS-50, dual Garmin GTX3000 transponders, GDL88 ADS-B Out, TCAS II, and RVSM. The eight-passenger cabin features grey leather with a mid-cabin club and aft 3-place divan, belted forward lavatory, and 110-volt outlets. Based in San Antonio, TX.

aircraft.highlight: Low time, Pro Line 21 with IFIS, TAP Blue engines, fresh Check 3.
aircraft.overview:
This 2005 Premier IA has just 2,835 total hours, with both Williams FJ44-2A engines enrolled on TAP Blue (fully paid, no deferrals) and avionics on CASP. Fresh off a Check 3 inspection at 2,468 hours, shows 308 hours since HSI on both engines, and complied with the 18-year inspection in September 2023. The Collins Pro Line 21 3-tube suite includes IFIS 5000 with electric charts and XM weather, FMS-3000 v4.0, TCAS II with Change 7, and RVSM, ADS-B Out, and WAAS/LPV certification.

The six-passenger executive cabin is finished in hazelnut leather with a mid-cabin club, bronze ribbon mahogany trim, aft lavatory, and 110-volt outlets. Matterhorn white with maroon stripes, both windshields recently replaced, CAMP tracking, based in Hoquiam, WA.
